prerequisites: Basic mathematical concepts included in other high school or first-semester subjects.

learning_outcomes.text: Understand the mechanisms of inheritance and polymorphism
Effectively use class inheritance and polymorphism in solving a simple problem
Effectively use exceptions in solving a simple problem
Effectively use defined input/output classes for reading binary and text files
Define the necessary unit tests to validate an application using standard mechanisms

syllabus_topics: Introduction to the Object-Oriented Programming Paradigm

assessment_methods.method: Practical test (HP) on inheritance and polymorphism
Practical test (EF) on exceptions and file handling

assessment_rules: For ordinary calls, a minimum of 5 out of 10 points is required for the theoretical block and for each practical test (HP and EF). The final theoretical grade is the TE score. The final practical grade is calculated as (0.8 × HP) + (0.2 × EF). If minimums are met, the final grade is (0.5 × Theory) + (0.5 × Practicals); otherwise, it's the minimum of 4.0 and the calculated score. For extraordinary calls, a minimum of 5 out of 10 is required for TE, HP, and EF. If minimums are met, the final grade is (0.5 × TE) + (0.4 × HP) + (0.1 × EF); otherwise, it's the minimum of 4.0 and the calculated score. Passing all evaluation tests is a requirement to pass the subject; the final grade can be increased by up to 20% by valuing submitted theory and practical exercises. In case of doubt regarding authorship or unauthorized means, a presential defense of the test may be requested.
